correctness.rationale: The direct finite S5 semantics gives w not in global someone-knows iff each coordinate w_i appears in some false world, hence exactly T\c_T(H). Projection preservation makes c_T extensive, monotone, idempotent. Möbius inversion on closed subsets gives exact fiber counts; on the full product each nonempty closed subset is a unique nonempty box, giving 1+product_i(2^{n_i}-1). A false set has full projection iff it is an edge cover; minimum size M on full products and corresponding surjection multiplicities follow. In bipartite correlated teams minimum edge cover = vertex count - maximum matching; in 3 parts the equal-size three-dimensional matching reduction proves NP-completeness for explicit T. Independently exhaustively enumerated all 4096 events of 2x2x3, obtaining 64 images and 36 optimal invisible valuations. This finite sample corroborates, not proves, the unrestricted results.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge distinct combined global observation image/fiber and correlated-team edge-cover complexity classification. Published fixed-owner secrecy-event size counting conditions on a designated star and non-owner coordinates, while distributed/coalition knowledge profiles count coalitions at one pointed world; neither statement implies the full global someone-knows operator fibers, arbitrary correlated-structure Möbius inversion or three-agent complexity boundary.
